external_sources.implication: The remaining route should model day-state and sleep-transition context jointly.
external_sources.takeaway: ETRI 2024 is explicitly built around passive 24-hour sensing from smartphones, smartwatches, sleep sensors, and self-reports for sleep quality and stress prediction.
external_sources.title: Understanding Human Daily Experience Through Continuous Sensing: ETRI Lifelog Dataset 2024

external_sources.implication: A future runner should preserve all 12 modalities and their missingness patterns.
external_sources.takeaway: The official data page lists 12 public lifelog streams and frames the task as sleep health, fatigue, and stress prediction from daily-life records.
external_sources.title: The 4th ETRI Human Understanding AI Paper Challenge data page

external_sources.implication: Image layout is useful as a representation prior, but local ID342 smokes say it is not enough alone.
external_sources.takeaway: PixleepFlow treats synchronized lifelog streams as composite images and targets sleep/stress jointly, reinforcing the need for cross-channel state representations.
external_sources.title: PixleepFlow: A Pixel-Based Lifelog Framework for Predicting Sleep Quality and Stress Level

external_sources.implication: A future image/sequence attempt should not replay stacked single images; it needs block-level temporal aggregation plus discrete-event handling and uncertainty checks.
external_sources.takeaway: MIS-LSTM partitions continuous sensor streams into multi-hour blocks, renders them as multi-channel images, encodes sparse discrete events separately with 1D-CNN, then aggregates block embeddings with LSTM.
external_sources.title: MIS-LSTM: Multichannel Image-Sequence LSTM for Sleep Quality and Stress Prediction

external_sources.implication: The next design should use cross-modal alignment/fusion with explicit robustness checks.
external_sources.takeaway: The survey emphasizes modality heterogeneity, alignment, noise, and missing modalities as central multi-modal time-series challenges.
external_sources.title: Multi-modal Time Series Analysis: A Tutorial and Survey

external_sources.implication: This is a strong template for phone/watch/sleep-context modality dropout and fusion.
external_sources.takeaway: CroSSL masks modality-specific latent embeddings and aggregates them into a global representation, while handling missing modalities without negative-pair sampling.
external_sources.title: CroSSL: Cross-modal Self-Supervised Learning for Time-series through Latent Masking

external_sources.implication: Missingness should be a first-class token, not a preprocessing nuisance to fill away.
external_sources.takeaway: LSM-2/AIM learns directly from inherited real-world missingness plus artificial masks instead of requiring explicit imputation.
external_sources.title: LSM-2: Learning from Incomplete Wearable Sensor Data

external_sources.implication: Use 30-minute to multi-hour windows as semantic units instead of minute-level reconstruction only.
external_sources.takeaway: TimeMAE raises masked modeling from individual points to sub-series semantic units, reducing cost and improving label-scarce transfer.
external_sources.title: TimeMAE: Self-Supervised Representations of Time Series with Decoupled Masked Autoencoders

external_sources.implication: Subject-day neighborhoods are plausible, but validation must prevent date/subject leakage.
external_sources.takeaway: TNC learns representations for non-stationary time series by contrasting local temporal neighborhoods against non-neighboring windows.
external_sources.title: Unsupervised Representation Learning for Time Series with Temporal Neighborhood Coding

external_sources.implication: Use as a secondary objective only after missingness-aware cross-modal masking is fixed.
external_sources.takeaway: TS2Vec learns hierarchical timestamp and subsequence representations through contrastive learning.
external_sources.title: TS2Vec: Towards Universal Representation of Time Series
